test_title: PYST 58: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The team always anticipate a bowling friendly __pitch on their easy victory__ in the T20 matches.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**for**" is the most appropriate to indicate purpose or intended outcome.
 
• The sentence suggests that the team anticipates a bowling-friendly pitch as beneficial for their easy victory, making "**pitch for their easy victory**" the correct substitution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** The team always anticipate a bowling-friendly pitch for their easy victory in the T20 matches.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• pitch over: Incorrect because "over" does not fit the context of purpose or expectation.
 
• pitch to: Incorrect because "to" suggests direction rather than purpose.
 
• pitch of: Incorrect because "of" implies possession or a feature, which is not suitable here.
